messages:
anya_cs: FYI - Sparrowfield cutover tomorrow. Customer reports two blockers: (A) our privdeploy role assumes fine but KMS Decrypt fails when our collector reads archived logs, (B) audit delivery appears in their bucket but CloudTrail shows a PutObject 403 for our delivery role. Need a quick triage and a low-risk workaround.

hoang_neteng: For the 403, please ask them to paste the S3 PutObject error and confirm whether the bucket enforces SSE-KMS. If it's SSE-KMS, both the key policy and bucket policy must allow the CloudTrail service principal + our delivery role.

marta_kms: Decrypt failures often mean the key policy lacks our forwarder principal or there's an org SCP blocking decryption. If they have SCP deny on kms:Decrypt we can't fix with a grant. Ask for a CloudTrail Deny event. Quick fix if no SCP: we can create a scoped grant from their CMK to the delivery role with an EncryptionContext constraint.

drew_sec: Security note: prefer scoped grants over broad key policy edits. Also avoid s3:BypassGovernanceRetention unless absolutely needed. For short-term audit delivery, recommend a separate delivery prefix that isn't under retention, or a scoped bucket policy that allows PutObject on that prefix from our exact assumed-role ARN.

ticket-bot: Reminder - Sparrowfield onboarding ticket #SF-609 needs cutover readiness update in 24h.

anya_cs: Action plan: (1) I'll request PutObject error and CloudTrail deny snippet; (2) Marta, can you draft the `aws kms create-grant` command with EncryptionContext example if customer confirms role ARN; (3) Hoang, ask them to confirm bucket prefix and whether retention/object-lock is enabled. If they can't allow a new prefix, we'll propose a scoped bucket policy and schedule a 15m bridge. Acks?

marta_kms: Ack. Drafting grant: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::445566778899:role/sparrowfield-delivery --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"service":"cloudtrail","project":"sparrowfield"}`. Will paste to SF-609.

hoang_neteng: Ack. Posting diagnostic asks now: (1) putobject error log, (2) cloudtrail event id for denied request, (3) s3 bucket retention settings, (4) assumed-role ARN from `aws sts get-caller-identity` on their delivery host.

drew_sec: Ack. I'll prepare the renewal-risk note: "Repeated temporary grants or bucket policy exceptions for audit delivery -> flag for managed support conversation at renewal."

anya_cs: Great. If we don't hear back in 90 minutes I'll open the bridge. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
